articles.title: 重新定义“矛盾性”兴奋：区分脑电图复杂性和熵揭示健康成人丙泊酚敏感性的静息态动力学
articles.originalTitle: Reframing "paradoxical" excitation: disentangling electroencephalogram complexity and entropy reveals resting-state dynamics associated with propofol susceptibility in healthy adults.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Propofol exposure can produce heterogeneous neural responses, from the expected suppression to transient paradoxical excitation. Electroencephalography (EEG) measures of signal complexity and entropy have emerged as reliable markers of consciousness, but different types of complexity and entropy measures are often conflated. We used Type I and II complexity measures on the complexity-entropy causal plane (CECP) to characterise divergent neural trajectories during propofol-induced loss of consciousness. We hypothesised that paradoxical excitation is reflected in both Type I and Type II complexity; that divergent trajectories on the CECP separate paradoxical excitation from suppression; and that baseline EEG complexity is associated with susceptibility to propofol. METHODS: We analysed EEG data from two independent cohorts of healthy adults receiving propofol: the Chennu dataset (n=20), which included resting-state baseline, mild, and moderate sedation, followed by a recovery period; and the ReCCognition dataset (n=8), which used escalating infusions from baseline to deep sedation. For each participant and sedation level, we extracted Lempel-Ziv complexity (Type I) and statistical complexity (Type II) and projected them onto the CECP. Pearson correlations related baseline statistical complexity to changes in statistical complexity during moderate sedation; behavioural responsiveness; effect-site propofol concentration; and time to loss of consciousness. RESULTS: At moderate sedation, participants who remained responsive showed paradoxical increases in Lempel-Ziv Complexity and decreases in statistical complexity, whereas unresponsive participants exhibited the opposite pattern. Baseline statistical complexity correlated negatively with both the change in statistical complexity (r=-0.88) and behavioural responsiveness, indicating that intrinsic brain dynamics influence individual susceptibility to sedation. CECP trajectories revealed a reproducible inflection point demarcating paradoxical excitation from suppression. CONCLUSIONS: Mapping EEG trajectories on the CECP bridges anaesthetic state transitions with underlying neural dynamics. Baseline EEG complexity indexes individual sensitivity to propofol, determining whether brain dynamics transiently enter excitation or direct suppression.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND:
sections.text: 丙泊酚暴露可产生异质性神经反应，从预期的抑制到短暂的矛盾性兴奋。脑电图（EEG）信号复杂性和熵的测量已成为意识的可靠标志物，但不同类型的复杂性和熵测量常被混淆。我们在复杂性-熵因果平面（CECP）上使用I型和II型复杂性测量来描述丙泊酚诱导意识丧失过程中的不同神经轨迹。我们假设：矛盾性兴奋在I型和II型复杂性中均有体现；CECP上的不同轨迹将矛盾性兴奋与抑制区分开；基线EEG复杂性与对丙泊酚的敏感性相关。

sections.heading: METHODS:
sections.text: 我们分析了两个独立健康成人队列接受丙泊酚的EEG数据：Chennu数据集（n=20），包括静息态基线、轻度、中度镇静，随后恢复期；以及ReCCognition数据集（n=8），使用从基线到深度镇静的递增输注。对于每位参与者和每个镇静水平，我们提取了Lempel-Ziv复杂性（I型）和统计复杂性（II型），并将其投影到CECP上。Pearson相关分析将基线统计复杂性分别与中度镇静期间统计复杂性的变化、行为反应性、效应室丙泊酚浓度以及意识丧失时间相关联。

sections.heading: RESULTS:
sections.text: 在中度镇静时，保持反应的参与者表现出Lempel-Ziv复杂性的矛盾性增加和统计复杂性的下降，而无反应参与者则呈现相反模式。基线统计复杂性与统计复杂性的变化（r=-0.88）及行为反应性均呈负相关，表明内在脑动力学影响个体对镇静的敏感性。CECP轨迹揭示了一个可重复的拐点，界定了矛盾性兴奋与抑制。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS:
sections.text: 在CECP上映射EEG轨迹将麻醉状态转换与潜在的神经动力学联系起来。基线EEG复杂性指示个体对丙泊酚的敏感性，决定了脑动力学是短暂进入兴奋状态还是直接进入抑制状态。

articles.title: 非心脏手术中示波法动脉压监测间隔："2.5分钟对比5分钟"随机临床试验
articles.originalTitle: Intervals for Oscillometric Arterial Pressure Monitoring during Noncardiac Surgery: The "2.5-Minute versus 5-Minute" Randomized Clinical Trial.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Guidelines recommend measuring arterial pressure at least every 5 min during surgery. However, it remains unknown whether shortening the measurement interval of intermittent oscillometric arterial pressure monitoring can help reduce intraoperative hypotension. This trial tested the primary hypothesis that oscillometric arterial pressure monitoring at 2.5-min versus 5-min intervals reduces intraoperative hypotension in noncardiac surgery patients with general anesthesia. METHODS: In this single-center trial, 264 noncardiac surgery patients were randomized to oscillometric arterial pressure measurements with an upper-arm cuff at 2.5-min or 5-min intervals during surgery. The primary outcome was the amount of intraoperative hypotension quantified as the time-weighted average mean arterial pressure (MAP) less than 65 mmHg during surgery assessed using blinded continuous finger-cuff arterial pressure monitoring. Secondary outcomes included the administered time-weighted cumulative amount of norepinephrine indexed to body weight. RESULTS: Of the 264 patients randomized (132 to each group), the primary outcome analysis included 132 patients in the 2.5-min group and 131 in the 5-min group. The median (IQR) time-weighted average MAP less than 65 mmHg was 0.00 (0.00, 0.04) mmHg in patients assigned to the 2.5-min group and 0.00 (0.00, 0.21) mmHg in patients assigned to the 5-min group (estimated location shift, -1.40 x 10 -5 mmHg; 95% CI, -6.64 x 10 -5 to 2.93 x 10 -6 mmHg; P = 0.27). Seven patients (5.3%) in the 2.5-min group had at least one 1-min episode of a MAP less than 50 mmHg versus 13 patients (9.9%) in the 5-min group ( P = 0.24). The median (IQR) time-weighted cumulative amount of norepinephrine indexed to body weight administered during surgery was 0.05 (0.03, 0.08) microg . kg -1 . min -1 in the 2.5-min group and 0.05 (0.02, 0.08) microg . kg -1 . min -1 in the 5-min group ( P = 0.40). CONCLUSIONS: In this trial of patients having elective low- to moderate-risk noncardiac surgery with general anesthesia, arterial pressure was tightly controlled with norepinephrine, and the amount of intraoperative hypotension was low-irrespective of the randomized arterial pressure measurement interval. Although oscillometric arterial pressure monitoring at 2.5-min intervals-compared to 5-min intervals-did not reduce the time-weighted average MAP less than 65 mmHg, the authors cannot exclude that monitoring at 2.5-min intervals helps reduce profound hypotension.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 指南建议术中至少每5分钟测量一次动脉压。然而，缩短间断示波法动脉压监测的测量间隔是否有助于减少术中低血压仍属未知。本试验验证主要假设：在全身麻醉的非心脏手术患者中，与5分钟间隔相比，2.5分钟间隔的示波法动脉压监测可减少术中低血压。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在这项单中心试验中，264例非心脏手术患者被随机分配至术中每2.5分钟或每5分钟使用上臂袖带进行示波法动脉压测量。主要结局是术中低血压的程度，以时间加权平均动脉压（MAP）低于65 mmHg的量化值表示，通过盲法连续指套动脉压监测进行评估。次要结局包括按体重指数化的时间加权累积去甲肾上腺素给药量。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在随机分组的264例患者中（每组132例），主要结局分析包括2.5分钟组132例和5分钟组131例。2.5分钟组患者的时间加权平均MAP低于65 mmHg的中位数（IQR）为0.00（0.00，0.04）mmHg，5分钟组为0.00（0.00，0.21）mmHg（估计位置偏移，-1.40 × 10^-5 mmHg；95% CI，-6.64 × 10^-5至2.93 × 10^-6 mmHg；P = 0.27）。2.5分钟组有7例（5.3%）患者出现至少一次MAP低于50 mmHg持续1分钟的事件，而5分钟组有13例（9.9%）（P = 0.24）。2.5分钟组术中按体重指数化的时间加权累积去甲肾上腺素给药量的中位数（IQR）为0.05（0.03，0.08）μg·kg^-1·min^-1，5分钟组为0.05（0.02，0.08）μg·kg^-1·min^-1（P = 0.40）。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在这项针对择期低至中危非心脏手术全身麻醉患者的试验中，无论随机分配的动脉压测量间隔如何，动脉压均通过去甲肾上腺素得到严格控制，术中低血压程度较低。尽管与5分钟间隔相比，2.5分钟间隔的示波法动脉压监测并未降低时间加权平均MAP低于65 mmHg，但作者不能排除2.5分钟间隔监测有助于减少严重低血压的可能性。

abstractTranslation.fullText: BACKGROUND: Guidelines recommend measuring arterial pressure at least every 5 min during surgery. However, it remains unknown whether shortening the measurement interval of intermittent oscillometric arterial pressure monitoring can help reduce intraoperative hypotension. This trial tested the primary hypothesis that oscillometric arterial pressure monitoring at 2.5-min versus 5-min intervals reduces intraoperative hypotension in noncardiac surgery patients with general anesthesia. METHODS: In this single-center trial, 264 noncardiac surgery patients were randomized to oscillometric arterial pressure measurements with an upper-arm cuff at 2.5-min or 5-min intervals during surgery. The primary outcome was the amount of intraoperative hypotension quantified as the time-weighted average mean arterial pressure (MAP) less than 65 mmHg during surgery assessed using blinded continuous finger-cuff arterial pressure monitoring. Secondary outcomes included the administered time-weighted cumulative amount of norepinephrine indexed to body weight. RESULTS: Of the 264 patients randomized (132 to each group), the primary outcome analysis included 132 patients in the 2.5-min group and 131 in the 5-min group. The median (IQR) time-weighted average MAP less than 65 mmHg was 0.00 (0.00, 0.04) mmHg in patients assigned to the 2.5-min group and 0.00 (0.00, 0.21) mmHg in patients assigned to the 5-min group (estimated location shift, -1.40 x 10 -5 mmHg; 95% CI, -6.64 x 10 -5 to 2.93 x 10 -6 mmHg; P = 0.27). Seven patients (5.3%) in the 2.5-min group had at least one 1-min episode of a MAP less than 50 mmHg versus 13 patients (9.9%) in the 5-min group ( P = 0.24). The median (IQR) time-weighted cumulative amount of norepinephrine indexed to body weight administered during surgery was 0.05 (0.03, 0.08) microg . kg -1 . min -1 in the 2.5-min group and 0.05 (0.02, 0.08) microg . kg -1 . min -1 in the 5-min group ( P = 0.40). CONCLUSIONS: In this trial of patients having elective low- to moderate-risk noncardiac surgery with general anesthesia, arterial pressure was tightly controlled with norepinephrine, and the amount of intraoperative hypotension was low-irrespective of the randomized arterial pressure measurement interval. Although oscillometric arterial pressure monitoring at 2.5-min intervals-compared to 5-min intervals-did not reduce the time-weighted average MAP less than 65 mmHg, the authors cannot exclude that monitoring at 2.5-min intervals helps reduce profound hypotension.

articles.title: 肝移植术中血流动力学管理与术后并发症：一项多中心队列研究
articles.originalTitle: Intraoperative Hemodynamic Management during Liver Transplantation and Postoperative Morbidity: A Multicenter Cohort Study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: The best intraoperative hemodynamic strategy in liver transplantation remains uncertain. No high-quality clinical trials or observational studies have comprehensively assessed the association between intraoperative hemodynamic management and postoperative outcomes in liver transplantation. This study aimed to measure the association between two key components of intraoperative hemodynamic management, fluid balance and vasopressor doses, and 7-day graft dysfunction or nonfunction and other postoperative complications after liver transplantation. METHODS: A multicenter cohort study was conducted across eight liver transplantation centers in Canada and France, including consecutive liver transplant recipients over at least 1 yr between January 2021 and May 2023. The exposures were intraoperative fluid balance (volume of blood products, transfused cell saver, colloids, and crystalloids (divided by 1.5), minus estimated blood loss, expressed in liters) and intraoperative vasopressor doses (expressed in increments of 25 mug/kg norepinephrine equivalents). The primary outcome was 7-day early allograft dysfunction or primary graft nonfunction. The study used regression models adjusted for confounders, including intraoperative hypotension. RESULTS: A total of 852 liver transplant recipients (836 with complete data) were included. Participants had a mean +/- SD age of 54 +/- 12 yr and a median [quartile 1, quartile 3] Model for End-stage Liver Disease (MELD) 3.0 score of 20 [11, 29]. The incidence of 7-day early allograft dysfunction or primary graft nonfunction was 28% (occurring in 236 patients). Neither fluid balance (adjusted risk ratio = 1.02 [95% CI, 0.97 to 1.06] for each liter of fluid balance) nor vasopressor doses (adjusted risk ratio = 1.03 [95% CI, 0.99 to 1.06] for each increment of 25 mug/kg of norepinephrine equivalent) were associated with the risk of this outcome. CONCLUSIONS: A higher fluid balance and higher doses of vasopressors were not associated with a higher risk of 7-day early allograft dysfunction or primary graft nonfunction after liver transplantation.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 肝移植术中最佳血流动力学策略仍不确定。尚无高质量临床试验或观察性研究全面评估术中血流动力学管理与肝移植术后结局之间的关联。本研究旨在测量术中血流动力学管理两个关键组成部分（液体平衡和血管加压药剂量）与肝移植术后7天移植物功能障碍或失功能及其他术后并发症之间的关联。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 在加拿大和法国的八个肝移植中心开展了一项多中心队列研究，纳入2021年1月至2023年5月期间至少1年内连续收治的肝移植受体。暴露因素为术中液体平衡（血液制品、回收式自体输血、胶体液和晶体液体积（除以1.5）减去估计失血量，以升表示）和术中血管加压药剂量（以25 μg/kg去甲肾上腺素等效剂量的增量表示）。主要结局为7天早期移植物功能障碍或原发性移植物失功能。研究使用校正了混杂因素（包括术中低血压）的回归模型。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 共纳入852例肝移植受体（836例数据完整）。参与者平均年龄±标准差为54±12岁，终末期肝病模型（MELD）3.0评分中位数[第一四分位数，第三四分位数]为20[11, 29]。7天早期移植物功能障碍或原发性移植物失功能的发生率为28%（发生于236例患者）。液体平衡（每升液体平衡的校正风险比=1.02 [95% CI, 0.97至1.06]）和血管加压药剂量（每增加25 μg/kg去甲肾上腺素等效剂量的校正风险比=1.03 [95% CI, 0.99至1.06]）均与该结局风险无关。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 较高的液体平衡和较高剂量的血管加压药与肝移植术后7天早期移植物功能障碍或原发性移植物失功能的风险升高无关。

abstractTranslation.fullText: BACKGROUND: 肝移植术中最佳血流动力学策略仍不确定。尚无高质量临床试验或观察性研究全面评估术中血流动力学管理与肝移植术后结局之间的关联。本研究旨在测量术中血流动力学管理两个关键组成部分（液体平衡和血管加压药剂量）与肝移植术后7天移植物功能障碍或失功能及其他术后并发症之间的关联。METHODS: 在加拿大和法国的八个肝移植中心开展了一项多中心队列研究，纳入2021年1月至2023年5月期间至少1年内连续收治的肝移植受体。暴露因素为术中液体平衡（血液制品、回收式自体输血、胶体液和晶体液体积（除以1.5）减去估计失血量，以升表示）和术中血管加压药剂量（以25 μg/kg去甲肾上腺素等效剂量的增量表示）。主要结局为7天早期移植物功能障碍或原发性移植物失功能。研究使用校正了混杂因素（包括术中低血压）的回归模型。RESULTS: 共纳入852例肝移植受体（836例数据完整）。参与者平均年龄±标准差为54±12岁，终末期肝病模型（MELD）3.0评分中位数[第一四分位数，第三四分位数]为20[11, 29]。7天早期移植物功能障碍或原发性移植物失功能的发生率为28%（发生于236例患者）。液体平衡（每升液体平衡的校正风险比=1.02 [95% CI, 0.97至1.06]）和血管加压药剂量（每增加25 μg/kg去甲肾上腺素等效剂量的校正风险比=1.03 [95% CI, 0.99至1.06]）均与该结局风险无关。CONCLUSIONS: 较高的液体平衡和较高剂量的血管加压药与肝移植术后7天早期移植物功能障碍或原发性移植物失功能的风险升高无关。

articles.title: 恢复室脑电图监测用于识别术后谵妄风险患者
articles.originalTitle: Electroencephalographic Monitoring in the Recovery Room for Identification of Patients at Risk for Postoperative Delirium.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Electroencephalography (EEG), especially the assessment of alpha oscillations (8 to 12 Hz), has gained attention as a noninvasive marker of neural network integrity, with reduced alpha power linked to thalamocortical disconnectivity and increased vulnerability to postoperative delirium (POD) in elderly patients. Recent studies have demonstrated that altered EEG dynamics in the alpha-band frequencies during anesthesia emergence in the postanesthesia care unit are associated with POD. However, EEG data postoperatively from the recovery room are scarce. METHODS: This prospective observational study (2019 to 2022) at Charite-Universitatsmedizin Berlin investigates frontal EEG signatures and POD in older adults undergoing surgery. Postoperative POD screening was performed in the recovery room and twice daily for 5 days. While the overall study collected pre- and intraoperative EEGs, this study focused on frontal EEG files recorded in the recovery room while patients were awake. Spectral-domain EEG features and monitor-derived indices were compared by multivariable regression analysis between those who developed POD and those who did not. RESULTS: A total of 184 patients had sufficient EEG data for analysis; 57 (31%) developed POD. Recovery-room recordings showed significantly reduced alpha- and beta-band power in patients with POD versus those without POD, with cumulative 10- to 20-Hz power providing the best discrimination (area under the receiver operating characteristic, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.60 to 0.77). Patients without POD exhibited increases in alpha- and beta-band power (8 to 20 Hz) relative to preoperative baseline, with the highest augmentation at approximately 16 Hz, whereas POD patients retained spectral patterns comparable to baseline across all frequency bands. CONCLUSIONS: These data suggest that frontal EEG monitoring in the recovery room can help identify a "vulnerable brain" phenotype associated with increased POD risk. Integrating this monitoring into postoperative care may support risk stratification and more individualized management.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 脑电图（EEG），尤其是评估α振荡（8至12 Hz），作为一种神经完整性的无创标志物已受到关注，α功率降低与丘脑皮质连接中断及老年患者术后谵妄（POD）易感性增加相关。近期研究表明，麻醉复苏室中麻醉苏醒期间α频段EEG动态变化与POD相关。然而，术后复苏室的EEG数据很少。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 本项前瞻性观察性研究（2019至2022年）在柏林夏里特医科大学进行，探究老年手术患者的额叶EEG特征与POD。在复苏室及术后5天内每日两次进行POD筛查。虽然整体研究收集了术前和术中的EEG，但本研究聚焦于患者在复苏室清醒状态下记录的额叶EEG文件。通过多变量回归分析比较发生POD与未发生POD患者的谱域EEG特征和监护仪衍生指标。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 共184名患者具有足够的EEG数据进行分析；57名（31%）发生了POD。复苏室记录显示，发生POD的患者与未发生POD的患者相比，α和β频段功率显著降低，累积10至20 Hz功率提供了最佳区分度（受试者工作特征曲线下面积，0.69；95% CI，0.60至0.77）。未发生POD的患者相对于术前基线表现出α和β频段（8至20 Hz）功率增加，最高增幅出现在约16 Hz处，而POD患者在所有频段保留了与基线相当的频谱模式。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 这些数据提示，复苏室的额叶EEG监测有助于识别与POD风险增加相关的“脆弱脑”表型。将这种监测整合到术后护理中可能支持风险分层和更个体化的管理。

articles.mainResults: 共184例患者，57例（31%）发生术后谵妄。恢复室记录显示，POD组α和β频段功率显著低于NoPOD组；累积10-20Hz功率的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.69（95% CI 0.60-0.77），为最佳判别指标。NoPOD组α和β功率较术前基线增加，而POD组频谱模式与基线相似。
limitations: 单中心设计且仅纳入70岁以上患者，限制外推性。
术后谵妄发生率31%虽在老年手术患者预期范围内，但可能不代表其他机构或手术人群。
因技术性脑电图采样问题排除107例，凸显常规临床中实施复杂神经生理监测的挑战。
仅采用额部电极记录，可能遗漏后部和顶叶区域的网络变化。
2分钟短暂记录时段可能未完全捕捉神经生理恢复的动态和波动性。
分析聚焦术后即刻，未研究脑电图模式的时间演变。
10-20 Hz频段为事后频率分解分析得出，非预先指定。
累积10-20 Hz功率仅显示中等判别能力（AUC 0.69），未达到临床稳健诊断性能通常所需的AUC≥0.70。
作为观察性研究而非前瞻性试验，脑电图分析期间未维持结局盲法。
practice: 恢复室脑电图监测可能有助于识别“脆弱大脑”表型，用于术后谵妄风险分层。
但当前证据为中等判别能力，尚不能替代现有临床评估工具。
未来需多中心、大样本研究验证其临床实用性及最佳阈值。
articles.editor: 当前内容支持恢复室脑电图与术后谵妄关联的结论，但限于中等判别能力和观察性设计。 过度解读风险：需警惕将关联视为因果，且AUC 0.69提示诊断性能有限，不宜过度解读为临床决策依据。
articles.whyItMatters: 术后谵妄是老年患者常见并发症，早期识别高危人群有助于预防和干预。该研究提示恢复室脑电图可能提供一种无创、便捷的风险分层手段，但临床转化仍需更多验证。
articles.background: 脑电图α振荡（8-12 Hz）被视为神经网络完整性的非侵入性标志物，α功率降低与丘脑皮质连接障碍及老年患者术后谵妄易感性增加相关。然而，恢复室术后脑电图数据尚缺乏。
